```{r setup, include=FALSE}
# load packages
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)
library(dplyr)
#working with time 
library(lubridate)
library(scales)
library(cowplot)

#rollmean is in the package zoo 
library(zoo)

```

```{r}
#
d50_ooidsize<-384
rOoid_um <- d50_ooidsize/2

#transform into cm
rOoid <- rOoid_um*0.0001 #cm

AreaOoid <- pi*(rOoid^2) #cm^2

VOoid <- (4/3)*pi*((rOoid)^3)  #cm^3
SGooid <- 2.8 #g/cm^3


PT_carbonateVol <- (0.16 *VOoid)/AreaOoid
#changes into g/ area time by using density
PT_carbonateVol

PT_carbonateVol*SGooid

#again but for flat mats
FM_carbonateVol <- (0.04 *VOoid)/AreaOoid
FM_carbonateVol

FM_carbonateVol*SGooid

```
